parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ api_key: $vars.TAVILY_API_KEY || '', query: $json.body.topic || $json.topic, search_depth: $json.body.depth || $json.depth || 'advanced', include_answer: true, max_results: $json.body.max_results || 5 }) }}
